fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
voiceTapTitle: Recording: say it, then tap Next step
voiceBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow the microphone for this page, or add an audio file instead.
voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record from the microphone. Add an audio file instead.
voiceReadFailed: That audio could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
voiceTimed: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps follow the moments you tapped.
voiceFitted: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps are spread to fit it.
voiceChanged: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. You changed the number of steps after recording, so the steps are spread to fit the voice.
voiceFit: Spread the steps to fit the voice
voiceNoSound: This browser cannot put sound into the video. The video will be made without it. You can add your voice in your editing app.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or fewer steps, and keep this page open while it records.
textLabel: Type your slides, one line per step
textHint: Each line appears as one step, in order. Start a new slide with a line that says slide. Up to 12 slides and 60 steps.
syntax: Syntax guide: everything you can write
syntaxHint: Tap Add to put a line in your slides.
boxes: Draw boxes around left and right text
picturesHint: Add a photo or logo, then tap where to show it: on the left, in the middle or on the right. Up to 6 pictures. They stay on your device and are not saved between visits.
picturesFull: You can add up to 6 pictures.
pictureFailed: That picture could not be read. Try a JPG or PNG file.
voiceHint: Record your voice while you tap through the steps, so each step appears when you say it. Or add an audio file you already have. Your voice stays on your device.
voiceReady: Tap Next step each time you move to the next point. The first slide title shows until your first tap.
empty: Write a first line above, for example: left: Factory
crowdedNote: Slide {n} has a lot of text, so it is drawn small. Split it into more slides for a bigger, easier read.
tip: Tip: save the video, then drop it into Instagram Edits, CapCut or InShot. If you added your voice here, the sound is already in the file.
credit: Left, right and middle items sit in rows. A second left, arrow or right line starts a new row.

syntaxItems.title: Text on the left, right or middle
syntaxItems.note: Each line is one step that slides in. A left and a right line next to each other share a row.
syntaxItems.code:
left: Factory
right: Port
center: Goods arrive

syntaxItems.title: Arrow between left and right
syntaxItems.note: Put the arrow line between a left and a right line. Its text is written above the arrow.
syntaxItems.code:
left: Factory
arrow: ships the goods
right: Port

syntaxItems.title: Arrow pointing back
syntaxItems.note: The same, but the arrow points from right to left.
syntaxItems.code:
left: Shop
arrow-back: sends feedback
right: Customer

syntaxItems.title: A new row
syntaxItems.note: A second left, arrow or right in a row starts the next row below.
syntaxItems.code:
left: Port
arrow: loads
right: Ship
left: Ship
arrow: sails
right: Harbour

syntaxItems.title: Arrow pointing down
syntaxItems.note: A downward arrow across the middle, with a label beside it.

syntaxItems.title: Big text
syntaxItems.note: One large word or number that pops in.

syntaxItems.title: Bullet points
syntaxItems.note: Start a line with a dash. Each point appears one after another.
syntaxItems.code:
- First point
- Second point
- Third point

syntaxItems.title: Heading for a slide
syntaxItems.note: A title at the top. Writing it after the word slide does the same.

syntaxItems.title: New slide
syntaxItems.note: A line that says slide, or three dashes, starts a new slide. Text after the word is its title.

syntaxItems.title: Icons
syntaxItems.note: An icon on its own line, with a caption after the name. Or put the name between colons at the start of left, right or middle text to show the icon above the words. The icon list below shows every name.
syntaxItems.code:
icon: truck Delivery
left: :factory: Factory
right: :ship: Ship

syntaxItems.title: Pictures
syntaxItems.note: Add a picture below, then use left-image, center-image or right-image with its name. Words after the name are a caption.

syntaxItems.title: New line in text
syntaxItems.note: Type \n where the text should break.

syntaxItems.title: Pause
syntaxItems.note: Holds the picture for the seconds you write, from 0.5 to 10. Useful while you are speaking.

syntaxItems.title: Comment
syntaxItems.note: A line starting with # is ignored.
syntaxItems.code: # This line is a note to myself

layout: Layout of left and right items
layoutHint: Automatic stacks the left item, the arrow and the right item on tall videos like Reels, so the text can be bigger, and puts them side by side on wide videos.
zoom: Zoom in a little on each step
iconsHint: Tap an icon to add it as its own line. To put one inside a box, write its name between colons before the text, like left: :truck: Delivery.
